learning.title: Every route out of suspended clears the same per-suspension state, and a person's call keeps the recorded basis
learning.trigger: A request state machine has more than one way back from suspended (an automatic resume from a recheck and an explicit resume from a person), and a field such as the pause-requested mark is set during suspension.
learning.mistake: The explicit resume left pause_requested_at set, so the next suspension of that request never paused its live run: the pause rule fires only while the mark is empty. Evaluating the person's call as a manual call dropped the label basis, so the next poll suspended the request again; evaluating it with the recorded origin alone failed for lack of label provenance on a manual prefetch.
learning.rule: Pair every field reset of a state machine with a test that suspends, resumes by each route, and suspends again. A person's call on an automatic request keeps the recorded label basis and swaps only the authority (the caller's live authority replaces the label applier's), so the label is still required.

verification.requirement: Leaving the mark set in either explicit-resume write fails the suspend, resume, suspend test, and the label-basis resume case fails when the caller's manual basis is used.
